sections.label: MRO pilot and appointments
sections.summary: Two MROs have been appointed and assisted the Court in four cases, with one pending, and the pilot will be reviewed.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To date, we have appointed two MROs and they have assisted the Court in four cases, with one pending.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The respondents in these cases were assessed to be unable to keep up with their maintenance obligations due to financial difficulties, rather than being unwilling to pay maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For such cases, further to providing a report on its findings to the Court, the MRO will also refer parties to the relevant organisations for assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The MRO pilot is a recent initiative, having just been implemented a couple of months ago.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We will continue to review its effectiveness so that the MRO is able to assist more litigants.

sections.label: Reviewing MRO pilot programme
sections.summary: The pilot programme is still in its early days and will continue to be reviewed and refined on maintenance-related issues.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In essence, I want to assure the Member that we want to ensure that the connectivity is still there.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will try our best to get MRO available and work with other organisations to see how we can find the persons who do not pay maintenance.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As I have mentioned in my answer, it is still early days into the pilot programme.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will continue to review this to refine it in such a way that we will be able to have a positive effect on maintenance-related issues.
